Every banked checkpoint's expected v2 STAMP. All but one of the real trees stamp; the exception is recorded under `unstamped` with its reason, because a gap that is written down is a gap and a gap that is silent is a bug.

THE `-hub` ROWS ARE THE ONES THAT MATTER MOST. A topology extracted from an upstream repo is only worth anything if the tree TENSORHUB SERVES is that topology, and the two differ in ways that are invisible from upstream: `krea-2-hub` is 20 members where krea ships 5, `qwen-image-hub` is 30 where Qwen ships 14, and `stable-audio-hub` is F16 throughout where stabilityai ships F32. Every one of them stamps the topology extracted from upstream, which is the property tensorfs#153 found SEVEN older records failing. Two of them stamp the SAME pair from two different hub repos (`qwen-image` / `qwen-image-edit-2511`, and `stable-audio-open` / `foundation-1`), which is where 'one document serves both checkpoints' stops being a claim carried over from a v1 description.

unstamped.qwen3.6-35b-a3b-fp8: NO v2 TOPOLOGY, and the reason is a MEASUREMENT, not an oversight. Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 carries 64196 tensors across 42 members; the bf16 release it is nominally a quantization of carries 1045 across 26. The fp8 release is not a requant of the bf16 packaging — it also splits the MoE experts — so it is a DIFFERENT topology, needing its own extraction and its own vllm rule. v1's `qwen3.6-35b-a3b.vllm-fp8@1` answered `satisfies` here on a 92-declaration pattern list, which is the vacuous admit v2 refuses to reproduce. Recorded, not papered over.
